name: herdr-delegate
description: Delegate self-contained steps to helper agents on other subscriptions (Kiro, Antigravity/agy, GitHub Copilot, Codex, another Claude Code account) through Herdr's herdr-core (hc): pick a helper by tier, launch it with a brief, act as its approval judge, collect its report, review it, clean up. Use when the person asks to offload or delegate work, when Claude's limits are tight, or when a router plan marks a step for herdr. Runs helpers in Herdr (hc on PATH) or, without Herdr, in direct mode.
